name: Habit app: interviews and scope cut

content.text: I did 12 student interviews. 7 of 9 who used habit apps quit within 2 weeks, mostly because they were doing it alone. Only 2 of 12 asked about offline use. Also most said leaderboards feel stressful.

That points to a pivot: make habits shared within a study group, so people check in together. Offline sync roughly doubles build time for a feature 2 of 12 asked for. Leaderboards look like a negative given the stress feedback.
Agreed. Pivot to study-group habits with a group check-in feed. Drop offline sync. Drop leaderboards. Park the AI coach for later, not MVP.
Then native Swift+Kotlin means two codebases for a solo dev. React Native with Expo gives one codebase and fast iteration. Revised MVP: about 6 weeks (5 to 8) without the sync layer.
OK, React Native + Expo, no native. 6 weeks. Group admins might want a web dashboard but that's for later.
